name: Void Override
description: Raised by flow 4 (policy-void) at day 61 when a policy's void timer fires unpaid. Extending the term instead of letting the void stand requires a written justification — there is no audit trail on a record edit anywhere in the platform, so the justification captured here, on this task's required form field, is the only record of why an override happened (spec §4.5.5).

task_actions.description: Confirm the term-extension override and record a justification

_notes.priority_and_tag: Both copied verbatim from contract artefact 4: priority `medium` (the space default; flow 4 policy-void writes it explicitly on this task kind) and tag `override`, which also feeds the §4.5.5 audit surface — the only cheap way to list every override raised.
_notes.no_referral_tag: Same load-bearing exclusion as Sanctions/Claims — no `referral` tag means flow 11 never acts on a Void Override task, however its status moves. This is what stops ticking this task's action from ever issuing a quote (§6.4).
_notes.COORDINATION_REQUIRED_view_override: This form action is pinned to policy_config's `override` view — a saved entry with id 'override' under policy_config.views.forms[]. That view does not exist yet: policy_config.json (wave 2/2b's file, not edited by wave 3) currently has only a `table` view, verified live by reading the file. The dependency is exact: (1) a views.forms[] entry with "id": "override", and (2) within it, a field node for `void_override_reason` (already present in policy_config's schema, description already reads 'Enforced by the task template's required form field, not by this schema') carrying `"rules": [{ "property": "required", "logic": true, "description": "..." }]` — the same rule shape used live in the CRM vertical (verticals/crm/record_configs/Deal.json, lost_reason.required) and confirmed against records-service's ViewNode/RecordViews model (no view-level or schema-level `required` flag exists outside a field's own `rules` array; the schema's top-level `required: []` is a different, always-on mechanism that would block every write to the record, not just this task's form). This is the ONLY place §4.5's 'mandatory' can live, per §6.4, because no audit trail on a record edit exists anywhere.
_notes.why_view_not_schema_required: Putting void_override_reason in policy_config.schema.required would make it mandatory on every write to every policy — including the ones that never touch voiding. The per-view `rules` mechanism scopes the requirement to exactly this form action, which is the only place a human is asked for it.
_notes.assignees: Deliberately left unset — see the Underwriting Review template's note; no real underwriter/authorised-override user id exists on this staging account to hardcode. recon-c build item 10 additionally names a CEL policy gate on `session.user_id`/`session.role` for reinstatement, which is a platform-work item, not a task-template field.
